decisive_items: Hyperreflective area at external retinal layers, disruption of ellipsoid zone, outer segment photoreceptor and interdigitation zone
Mosaic-like hyporeflective outer retinal space with flat RPE
Partial restoration of ellipsoid zone, hyporeflective defect at interdigitation zone
response.rationale: Acute unilateral vision loss after high-intensity LED exposure with outer retinal OCT disruption and subsequent restoration best fits phototoxic maculopathy; R1 is the most specific supported diagnosis.

rejected.why: Retinal dystrophy is chronic/progressive and would not show acute onset with near-complete recovery after LED exposure.
Retinal damage of the right eye is anatomically descriptive but not an etiologic diagnosis and lacks specificity.
Retinal recovery describes the observed course, not the underlying diagnosis.
Maculopathy is correct but less specific than phototoxic maculopathy given the clear phototoxic exposure and OCT pattern.
Optic neuropathy is unsupported by normal anterior segment/fundus and by outer retinal OCT abnormalities rather than optic nerve findings.
